HEIF / HEIC runtime included with Image Compressor

This directory preserves third-party license texts, upstream build recipes,
the installed Windows wheel metadata, source locations and native file hashes.
The bundled native libraries are unmodified copies from the official PyPI
pillow_heif-1.8.0-cp313-cp313-win_amd64.whl distribution.

Detected Windows runtime versions:
  pillow-heif 1.8.0
  libheif 1.23.4
  libde265 1.1.3
  x265 4.3+1-e9b8812

Upstream licenses:
  pillow-heif source: BSD-3-Clause.
  Official binary wheel: its LICENSES_bundled.txt declares GPLv2 due to the
  bundled libraries. This declaration is reproduced unchanged in licenses/.
  libheif and libde265: GNU LGPL version 3.
  x265: GNU GPL version 2 or later, as stated in its source headers.
  libgcc/libstdc++: GNU GPL version 3 with GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1.
  MinGW-w64 winpthreads: MIT and BSD notices in COPYING-winpthreads.txt.

The installed wheel's bundled-license notice lists x265 4.2, but its Windows
encoder and DLL strings report 4.3+1-e9b8812. The manifest records the detected
version and the matching official MulticoreWare source commit:
e9b88125dc21393b3fd8d68e98083bdfb89778a8.

Matching core source locations:
  https://github.com/bigcat88/pillow_heif/tree/v1.8.0
  https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/tree/v1.23.4
  https://github.com/strukturag/libde265/tree/v1.1.3
  https://github.com/Multicorewareinc/x265/tree/e9b88125dc21393b3fd8d68e98083bdfb89778a8

manifest.json contains source-archive URLs, the PyPI wheel/sdist checksums,
the detected runtime information, seven native binary checksums, and the
provenance of every retained license and build-recipe file.
wheel-metadata/ retains the installed METADATA, WHEEL, RECORD and DELVEWHEEL.
build-recipes/ retains the upstream wheel workflow, setup and build scripts.
Windows wheel builds obtain native dependencies through MSYS2; exact MSYS2
runtime package revisions are not identified by the installed wheel metadata.

Source archives are not embedded in this directory or in the EXE. Retaining
license texts and source URLs alone does not substitute for the corresponding
source/relinking terms in the GPL/LGPL when distributing covered binaries.
This notice records third-party licenses and does not grant or change a
license for Image Compressor's own source code.
